title: Staff of Moses: text and later tradition chronology

creator_claim.verbatim_excerpt: from the staff of Moses that was taken from the garden of Eden

episodes.label: Moses holds a rod at the call
episodes.supports: The rod becomes a serpent and returns to a rod; no Eden provenance given.

episodes.label: Rod used for signs
episodes.supports: Moses is instructed to take the rod; verse 20 calls it the rod of God.

episodes.label: Aaron's rod before Pharaoh
episodes.supports: Aaron casts down his rod; the passage does not explicitly identify it as the same physical object as Moses's rod.

episodes.label: Rod at Horeb
episodes.supports: Moses is told to take the rod with which he struck the river and strike the rock.

episodes.label: Aaron's budding rod
episodes.supports: The named rod of Levi buds; this text does not supply a chain linking it to the rod of Exodus 4.

traditions.supports: Narrates a chain from Eden through patriarchal custodians to Jethro and Moses; not a modern museum custody record.
Summarizes traditions that identify Moses's and Aaron's rods; not independent proof of physical identity.

questions: Which textual witness first gives the complete Eden-to-Moses chain?
Can the chronology of the later midrash be dated securely?
Is any surviving object supported by a documented physical chain of custody?
